title.zh: 卷十六 本紀第十六 神宗三
title.raw: 卷十六 本紀第十六 神宗三 Volume 16 Annals 16: Shenzong 3

sentences.zh: 三年春正月乙丑朔，以大行太皇太后在殯，不視朝。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day yichou new moon: because the late Grand Dowager Empress lay in coffin, court audience was not held.
translations.idiomatic: Spring, year three, yichou new moon: the court held no audience while the late empress dowager lay in state.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，升許州爲潁昌府。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Xu prefecture was elevated to Yingchang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Xu was raised to Yingchang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙子，降潁昌囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Yingchang prisoners’ crimes were reduced one degree; those below forced labor were released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Yingchang sentences were lightened one grade and laborers were freed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上太皇太后諡曰慈聖光獻。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the Grand Dowager Empress was given posthumous title Cisheng Guangxian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the late empress dowager received the title Cisheng Guangxian.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔審刑院、刑部斷議官失入者，歲具數罰之。

translations.literal: Day wuzi, edict: Review of Punishments and Ministry of Justice sentencing officials who erred in judgment were to report numbers yearly and be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, misjudging sentencing officials faced yearly tallies and penalties.

sentences.zh: 己丑，高麗國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Goryeo presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 白虹貫日。

translations.literal: A white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: A white rainbow crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，于闐國大首領阿令顛顙溫等來貢。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Khotan grand chieftain Alingdian Suwen and others came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Khotan’s chief Alingdian Suwen and others offered tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day guisi: a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, a white rainbow crossed the sun again.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午，以翰林學士章惇參知政事。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingwu: Hanlin academician Zhang Dun was made participating administrator of affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingwu: Zhang Dun joined the council as participating administrator.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，始御崇政殿視朝。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: for the first time he held court audience in Chongzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the throne first held audience in Chongzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命輔臣禱雨。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: chief ministers were ordered to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, chief ministers were told to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，工部侍郎、同平章事吳充罷爲觀文殿大學士、西太一宮使。

translations.literal: Third month, day yichou: Vice Minister of Works and associate grand councilor Wu Chong was dismissed and made Hanlin scholar-at-large and West Great One Palace commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, yichou: Wu Chong left the council for Hanlin scholar-at-large and West Great One commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，葬慈聖光獻皇后于永昭陵。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Empress Cisheng Guangxian was buried at Yongzhao mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Cisheng Guangxian was interred at Yongzhao.

sentences.zh: 丙子，南丹州入貢，以刺史印賜之。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Nandan prefecture submitted tribute; a prefect’s seal was bestowed on it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Nandan paid tribute and received a prefect’s seal.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，祔慈聖光獻皇后神主于太廟。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the spirit tablet of Empress Cisheng Guangxian was enshrined in the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, her tablet joined the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊子，降兩京、河陽囚罪一等，民緣山陵役者，蠲其賦。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: prisoners in the Two Capitals and Heyang had crimes reduced one degree; commoners serving mausoleum labor were exempted from levies.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, capital and Heyang sentences were lightened and mausoleum laborers were freed from tax.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以慈聖光獻皇后弟昭德軍節度使曹佾爲司徒兼中書令，改護國軍節度使，余親屬加恩有差。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Empress Cisheng Guangxian’s younger brother Zhaode army commissioner Cao Yi was made Grand Mentor concurrently Grand Councilor and changed to Huguo army commissioner; remaining kin received favor in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Cao Yi became grand mentor and councilor, took Huguo command, and kin were rewarded by degree.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，觀文殿大學士吳充薨。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yiwei: Hanlin scholar-at-large Wu Chong died.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, yiwei: Wu Chong died.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，封宗暉爲濮陽郡王，濮安懿王子孫皆進官一等。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Prince Zonghui was enfeoffed Prince of Puyang; descendants of Prince Pu’an Yi all advanced one rank in office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Zonghui became Prince of Puyang and Pu’an Yi’s line rose one grade.

sentences.zh: 己亥，遼遣耶律永芳等來賀同天節。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Liao sent Yelü Yongfang and others to congratulate the Shared Heaven festival.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Yelü Yongfang came from Liao for Shared Heaven.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以瀘州夷乞弟侵擾，詔邊將討之。

translations.literal: Day yisi: because Luzhou barbarian Qi Di was raiding, an edict ordered border generals to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Qi Di’s Luzhou raids drew orders for border commanders to strike.

sentences.zh: 戊申，乞弟寇戎州，兵官王宣等戰歿。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Qi Di raided Rong prefecture; military officer Wang Xuan and others died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Qi Di hit Rongzhou; Wang Xuan and others fell.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，罷群牧行司，復置提舉買馬監牧司。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the collective pasturage acting office was abolished; the Directorate for Purchasing Horses and Overseeing Pasturage was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the pastoral acting office closed and the horse-purchase directorate returned.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，令御史分案諸路監司。

translations.literal: Day yimao: censors were ordered to divide cases over circuit supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, censors were assigned cases over circuit commissioners.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔御史台六察以糾劾多寡爲殿最，任滿取旨升黜。

translations.literal: Day gengshen, edict: the Censorate’s six surveillance bureaus took number of impeachments as grade criteria; at term end promotions and demotions followed imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, censorial bureaus were ranked by impeachment counts and posted by imperial order.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，增國子監歲賜錢六千緡。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the Directorate of Education’s yearly grant was increased by six thousand strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the imperial academy gained six thousand strings yearly.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑，詔自今三伏內，五日一御前殿。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yichou, edict: from now during the three fu periods, once every five days hold audience in the front hall.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yichou: during the three fu heats, audience came every five days.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以潁昌進士劉堂上《制盜十策》，授徐州蕭縣尉。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Yingchang jinshi Liu Tang submitted “Ten Policies on Suppressing Banditry” and was appointed Xiao county magistrate of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Liu Tang’s ten anti-bandit policies won him Xiao county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 甲申，復命韓存寶經制瀘夷。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Han Cunbao was again ordered to direct operations against Luz barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Han Cunbao resumed command over Luz barbarians.

sentences.zh: 詔改都大提舉導洛通汴司爲都提舉汴河堤岸司。

translations.literal: Edict: the Grand Directorate for Guiding Luo and Connecting Bian was changed to the Grand Directorate for Bian River Embankments.
translations.idiomatic: The Luo-Bian water office became the Bian embankment directorate.

sentences.zh: 是月，青州臨朐、益都石化爲面。

translations.literal: That month, stone at Linqu and Yidu in Qingzhou turned into flour.
translations.idiomatic: That month, stone at Linqu and Yidu reportedly turned to flour.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，日有五色雲。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiawu: the sun had five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiawu: five-colored clouds ringed the sun.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔省宗室教授，存十三員。

translations.literal: Day wuxu, edict: palace lecturers for the imperial clan were reduced, keeping thirteen posts.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, clan lecturers were cut to thirteen.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔中書詳定官制。

translations.literal: Day bingwu, edict: the Secretariat was to draft the official hierarchy in detail.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the Secretariat was to codify the official hierarchy.

sentences.zh: 罷兵部勾當公事官。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War’s duty-assignment officials were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: War ministry assignment clerks were abolished.

sentences.zh: 詔河北、河東、陝西路各選文武官一員提舉義勇保甲。

translations.literal: Edict: Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi circuits each chose one civil or military officer to oversee righteous volunteers and baojia militia.
translations.idiomatic: Each of Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi posted one officer for volunteers and baojia.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔罷中書門下省主判官，歸其事於中書。

translations.literal: Day renzi, edict: chief administrators of the Secretariat-Chancellery were abolished; matters returned to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Secretariat-Chancellery chief administrators were removed and work went to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是月，安州、臨江軍產芝及連理麥。

translations.literal: That month, Anzhou and Linjiang army produced fungus and conjoined wheat stalks.
translations.idiomatic: That month, auspicious fungus and twin wheat appeared at An and Linjiang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，河決澶州。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengwu: the Yellow River breached at Cao prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, gengwu: the Yellow River broke at Cao.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔自今遇大禮罷上尊號。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu, edict: from now when great rites occurred, offering honorific titles to the emperor was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, great rites no longer brought honorific titles for the throne.

sentences.zh: 癸未，彗出太微垣。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: a comet appeared in the Taiwei enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, a comet rose in the Taiwei asterism.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，避殿減膳，詔求直言。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: he withdrew from the hall and reduced meals; an edict sought blunt counsel.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the throne left court, ate sparingly, and called for frank remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，罷群神從祀明堂。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: all gods following sacrifice at the Bright Hall were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, minor gods were dropped from Bright Hall rites.

sentences.zh: 戊子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Venus shone at noon.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳，罷省、寺、監官領空名者。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yisi: officials in ministries, directorates, and offices who held empty titles were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yisi: honorary posts in ministries and directorates were stripped.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，遣王存等賀遼主生辰、正旦。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Wang Cun and others were sent to congratulate the Liao ruler’s birthday and New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Wang Cun’s mission wished Liao birthday and New Year.

sentences.zh: 戊午，彗不見。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the comet was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the comet faded.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，增宣祖定州東安墳地二十頃及守園戶。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renxu: Xuanzu’s Dong’an tomb lands at Dingzhou were increased by twenty qing and tomb guardians were added.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renxu: twenty qing and guard households were added to Xuanzu’s Ding tomb.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: he resumed holding hall audiences and normal meals.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the throne returned to court and full rations.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，正官名。

translations.literal: Day yihai: official titles were regularized.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, official titles were standardized.

sentences.zh: 以開府儀同三司易中書令、侍中、同平章事，特進易左、右僕射，自是以下至承務郎易秘書省校書郎、正字、將作監主簿有差，檢校僕射以下及階散憲銜並罷，詳在《職官志》。

translations.literal: Open-folder parity with triple grandees replaced Grand Councilor, Vice Grand Councilor, and associate grand councilor; specially advanced replaced left and right vice premiers; from there down to court gentleman for attendance duties were exchanged for Secretariat proofreaders, rectifiers, and Directorate of Works registrars with differences; acting vice premiers and below and honorary, scattered, and titular ranks were all abolished; details in Offices and Titles.
translations.idiomatic: Grand councilor posts became open-folder grandees, vice premiers became specially advanced, lower ranks were remapped to secretariat and works clerks, and acting or honorary titles were dropped—see Offices and Titles.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，大饗明堂，以英宗配，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: great Bright Hall sacrifice; Emperor Yingzong was paired; amnesty for all under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the Bright Hall rite paired Yingzong and an empire-wide amnesty followed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，薛向、孫固並爲樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Xue Xiang and Sun Gu both became vice military affairs commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Xue Xiang and Sun Gu joined the military commission as deputies.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔即景靈宮作十一殿，以時王禮祠祖宗。

translations.literal: Day yiyou, edict: immediately build eleven halls at Jingling Palace to sacrifice to ancestors with seasonal rites of kings.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Jingling gained eleven halls for seasonal ancestral rites.

sentences.zh: 以王安石爲特進，改封荊國公。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi was made specially advanced and enfeoffed Duke of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi became specially advanced Duke of Jing.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，進封岐王顥爲雍王，嘉王頵爲曹王，並爲司空。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Prince of Qi Hao was advanced to Prince of Yong; Prince of Jia Juan was advanced to Prince of Cao; both were made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Hao became Prince of Yong and Juan Prince of Cao, both works ministers.

sentences.zh: 文彥博爲太尉。

translations.literal: Wen Yanbo was made Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Yanbo became grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 封曹佾爲濟陽郡王，宗旦爲華陰郡王。

translations.literal: Cao Yi was enfeoffed Prince of Jiyang commandery; Zongdan Prince of Huayin commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Yi became Prince of Jiyang and Zongdan Prince of Huayin.

sentences.zh: 馮京爲樞密使。

translations.literal: Feng Jing was made military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Jing headed the military commission.

sentences.zh: 薛向罷知潁州。

translations.literal: Xue Xiang was dismissed and made prefect of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Xiang left for Ying prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以呂公著爲樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Lü Gongzhu was made vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Lü Gongzhu joined the military commission as deputy.

sentences.zh: 閏九月乙卯，加文彥博河東、永興軍節度使，以富弼爲司徒。

translations.literal: Intercalary ninth month, day yimao: Wen Yanbo was given Hedong and Yongxing army commands; Fu Bi was made Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary ninth month, yimao: Wen Yanbo took Hedong and Yongxing; Fu Bi became grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑朔，日當食，雲陰不見。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jichou new moon: an eclipse was due but clouds covered and it was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jichou new moon: an eclipse was due but clouds hid it.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，遼遣蕭偉等來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiachen: Liao sent Xiao Wei and others to congratulate New Year.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiachen: Xiao Wei came from Liao for New Year.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月乙未，命步軍都虞候林廣代韓存寶經制瀘夷。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, day yiwei: Infantry Command vice director Lin Guang was ordered to replace Han Cunbao directing Luz barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Spring, year four, yiwei: Lin Guang replaced Han Cunbao over Luz barbarians.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔試進士加律義。

translations.literal: Day gengzi, edict: civil examination graduates were to add penal code interpretation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, jinshi candidates faced an added penal-code section.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，于闐來貢。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Khotan came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Khotan presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 馮京罷知河陽。

translations.literal: Feng Jing was dismissed and made Heyang prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Jing left for Heyang.

sentences.zh: 孫固知樞密院，龍圖閣直學士韓縝同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Sun Gu headed the Bureau of Military Affairs; Dragon Diagram Pavilion academician Han Zhen was made co-administrator of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Gu led the military commission and Han Zhen served as co-administrator.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，置秦州鑄錢監。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinwei: Qinzhou coin mint was established.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, xinwei: Qinzhou got a mint.

sentences.zh: 己卯，分東南團結諸軍爲十三將。

translations.literal: Day jimao: southeastern united armies were divided into thirteen commands.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, southeast united troops split into thirteen commands.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未，詔在京官毋舉辟執政有服親。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiwei, edict: capital officials were forbidden to recommend kin within mourning relationship to chief administrators.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, yiwei: capital officials could not recommend mourning kin to the council.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，章惇罷知蔡州。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Zhang Dun was dismissed and made Cai prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Zhang Dun went to Cai prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以翰林學士張璪參知政事。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Hanlin academician Zhang Zao was made participating administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Zhang Zao joined the council.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命官閱九軍營陣法于京城南。

translations.literal: Day yisi: officials were ordered to review the nine armies’ battle formations south of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, officials inspected nine-army formations south of the city.

sentences.zh: 戊申，大閱。

translations.literal: Day wushen: grand review.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, a grand military review was held.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，董氈遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Dongzhan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Dongzhan offered tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，遼遣耶律祐等來賀同天節。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guihai: Liao sent Yelü You and others to congratulate the Shared Heaven festival.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guihai: Yelü You came from Liao for Shared Heaven.

sentences.zh: 御延和殿閱試保甲。

translations.literal: He held baojia review and examination in Yanhe Hall.
translations.idiomatic: At Yanhe Hall the throne reviewed baojia drills.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔罷南郊合祭天地，自今親祀北郊，如南郊儀，有故不行，則以上公攝事。

translations.literal: Day jisi, edict: southern suburban joint sacrifice of heaven and earth was abolished; henceforth the emperor personally sacrifices at the northern suburb with southern rites; if unable, a highest duke acts in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, combined southern rites ended; the throne would worship at the northern suburb, with a senior duke as stand-in when needed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day renshen: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 山陰縣主簿餘行之謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Shanyin county registrar Yu Xingzhi plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xingzhi of Shanyin rebelled and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，河決澶州小吳埽。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the Yellow River breached at Xiaowusao in Cao prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the Yellow River broke Xiaowusao at Cao.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，詔河東路提點刑獄劉定專振被水民。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingyou, edict: Hedong circuit judicial intendant Liu Ding was to focus on relief for flood victims.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, dingyou: Liu Ding was to aid Hedong flood victims.

sentences.zh: 戊申，封晉程嬰爲成信侯，公孫杵臼爲忠智侯，立廟於絳州。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Jin’s Cheng Ying was enfeoffed Marquis of Chengxin; Gongsun Chujiu Marquis of Zhongzhi; temples were established at Jiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Cheng Ying and Gongsun Chujiu received marquisates and temples at Jiang.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，河北諸郡蝗生。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuwu: locusts appeared in Hebei commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, wuwu: locusts struck Hebei.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命提點開封府界諸縣公事楊景略、提舉開封府界常平等事王得臣督諸縣捕蝗。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Kaifeng metropolitan border counties intendant Yang Jinglüe and metropolitan equalization commissioner Wang Dechen were ordered to oversee all counties in catching locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Yang Jinglüe and Wang Dechen directed metropolitan counties against locusts.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jichou: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jichou: Venus at noon.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，西邊守臣言夏人囚其主秉常，詔陝西、河東路討之。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: western border commanders reported Xia people had imprisoned their lord Bingchang; an edict ordered Shaanxi and Hedong circuits to campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Xia’s imprisonment of Bingchang brought orders for Shaanxi and Hedong to attack.

sentences.zh: 甲午，鄜延、涇原、環慶、熙河、麟府路各賜金銀帶、錦襖、銀器、鞍轡、象笏。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Fuyan, Jingyuan, Huanqing, Xihe, and Linfu circuits each received gold and silver belts, brocade jackets, silver vessels, saddles and bridles, and ivory tablets.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, five western circuits received belts, brocade, silver, saddlery, and ivory tablets.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，韓存寶坐逗留無功伏誅。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Han Cunbao was executed for lingering without achievement.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Han Cunbao was put to death for delay and failure.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大軍進攻米脂砦。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the main army advanced to attack Mizhi fortress.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, imperial forces assaulted Mizhi fort.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔曾鞏充史館修撰，專典史事。

translations.literal: Day jiyou, edict: Zeng Gong was made History Institute compiler, specializing in historical affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Zeng Gong was named history compiler in charge of annals.

sentences.zh: 詔內外官司舉官悉罷。

translations.literal: Edict: all internal and external offices recommending officials were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: All official nomination by ministries was abolished.

sentences.zh: 令大理卿崔台符同尚書吏部，審官東西、三班院議選格。

translations.literal: Court of Judicial Review director Cui Taifu was ordered together with Ministry of Personnel, Eastern and Western review bureaus, and Third Rank Court to discuss selection standards.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Taifu joined Personnel and the review bureaus to draft selection rules.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯朔，罷中書堂選，悉歸有司。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yimao new moon: Secretariat selection was abolished; all returned to relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yimao new moon: Secretariat promotions ended and selection returned to the ministries.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔蠲河北東路災傷州軍今年夏料役錢。

translations.literal: Day bingchen, edict: this year’s summer material and corvée levies in Hebei East circuit disaster-hit prefectures and armies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, summer levies were forgiven in storm-hit Hebei East posts.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，夏人寇臨川堡，詔董氈會兵伐之。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Xia raided Linchuan fort; an edict ordered Dongzhan to unite troops and campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, a Xia raid on Linchuan drew Dongzhan into counterattack.

sentences.zh: 以金州刺史燕達爲武康軍節度使。

translations.literal: Jin prefect Yan Da was made Wukang army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Da moved from Jin to Wukang command.

sentences.zh: 己巳，復置滑州。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Huazhou was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Huazhou was re-established.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，熙河經制李憲敗夏人於西市新城，獲酋首三人、首領二十余人。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Hexi frontier commissioner Li Xian defeated Xia at Xishi New City, capturing three chieftains and more than twenty leaders.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Li Xian routed Xia at Xishi New City and took three chieftains and over twenty leaders.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，又襲破于女遮穀，斬獲甚衆。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: he again raided and broke them at Nüzhe Valley, with many killed and captured.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Li Xian struck again at Nüzhe Valley and took a heavy toll.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，司馬光、趙彥若上所修《百官公卿年表》十卷，《宗室世表》三卷。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Sima Guang and Zhao Yanruo presented their compiled Annals of Officials and Nobles in ten juan and Genealogical Tables of the Imperial Clan in three juan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Sima Guang and Zhao Yanruo submitted ten juan of official annals and three juan of clan tables.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，董氈遣使來貢，且言已遣首領洛施軍篤喬阿公等將兵三萬會擊夏國。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yiyou: Dongzhan sent envoys with tribute and reported that leaders Luoshi, Junduqiao, Agong, and others were leading thirty thousand troops to join the strike on Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yiyou: Dongzhan’s tribute envoys promised thirty thousand allies under Luoshi and Junduqiao for the Xia campaign.

sentences.zh: 李憲復蘭州古城。

translations.literal: Li Xian recovered Lanzhou’s old city.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xian retook ancient Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，蘭州新順首領巴令謁等三族率所部兵攻夏人撒逋宗城，敗之。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: three Xinshun tribes led by Balinye and others attacked Xia at Sabozong city and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Balinye’s three allied tribes stormed Sabozong and beat the Xia garrison.

sentences.zh: 己亥，王珪上《國朝會要》。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Wang Gui presented the Institutional Compendium of Our Dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Wang Gui submitted the dynastic institutional compendium.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，閱河北保甲於崇政殿，官其優者三十六人。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Hebei baojia were reviewed at Chongzheng Hall; thirty-six outstanding men were given office.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the court reviewed Hebei baojia at Chongzheng Hall and commissioned thirty-six top men.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，祥定郊廟奉祀禮儀。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: suburban and temple sacrifice rituals were clarified and fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, suburban and temple rites were codified.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔諭夏主左右并嵬名部族諸部首領，并許自歸。

translations.literal: Day bingwu, edict: the Xia ruler’s attendants and Weiming clan leaders were all notified and permitted to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Xia courtiers and Weiming chiefs were told they might come over freely.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太白犯斗。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Venus trespassed the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Venus crossed the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，夏兵救米脂砦，鄜延經略副使-种諤率衆擊破之。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Xia troops relieved Mizhi fortress; Fuyan deputy frontier commissioner Zhong E led the force and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Zhong E smashed Xia relief columns marching on Mizhi.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，种諤又敗夏人於無定川。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Zhong E again defeated Xia on the Wuding River.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Zhong E beat Xia again at the Wuding River.

sentences.zh: 十月丁巳，米脂砦降。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day dingsi: Mizhi fortress surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, dingsi: Mizhi fortress capitulated.

sentences.zh: 己未，拂菻國來貢。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Fuolin sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Fuolin presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚申，熙河兵至女遮谷，與夏人遇，戰敗之。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Hexi troops reached Nüzhe Valley, met Xia, fought, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Hexi troops met and routed Xia at Nüzhe Valley.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，涇原兵至磨哆隘，遇夏人，與其統軍梁大王戰，敗之，追奔二十里，斬大首領沒囉臥沙、監軍使梁格鬼等十五級，獲首領統軍侄訖多埋等二十二人。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Jingyuan troops reached Moduo Pass, met Xia, and fought their grand marshal Liang the Great King; they were defeated, pursued twenty li, and fifteen heads were taken, including great chieftain Moluowosha and supervising commissioner Liang Gegei; twenty-two leaders including Military Commissioner’s nephew Qiduomai were captured.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Jingyuan troops crushed Liang the Great King at Moduo Pass, chased them twenty li, and took fifteen heads and twenty-two prisoners.

sentences.zh: 己巳，入銀州。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the army entered Yinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Song forces entered Yinzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，環慶行營經略使高遵裕復清遠軍。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Huanqing field army commissioner Gao Zunyu recovered Qingyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Gao Zunyu retook Qingyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 种諤遣曲珍等領兵通黑水安定堡，路遇夏人，與戰，破之，斬獲甚衆。

translations.literal: Zhong E sent Qu Zhen and others to open the route through Black Water and Anding fortress; on the road they met Xia, fought, broke them, and killed and captured in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong E sent Qu Zhen to secure Black Water and Anding; en route they ambushed Xia and took many heads.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，復韋州。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Weizhou was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Weizhou was retaken.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，李憲敗夏人于屈吳山。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Li Xian defeated Xia at Quwu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Li Xian routed Xia at Quwu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，曲珍與夏人戰於蒲桃山，敗之。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Qu Zhen fought Xia at Putao Mountain and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Qu Zhen beat Xia at Putao Mountain.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，种諤入夏州。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Zhong E entered Xiazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Zhong E marched into Xiazhou.

sentences.zh: 詔諸將存撫降人。

translations.literal: Edict: generals were to care for and settle those who surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Generals were ordered to feed and register the surrendered.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，史館修撰曾鞏乞收采名臣高士事蹟遺文，詔從之。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: historiographical compiler Zeng Gong asked to gather deeds and surviving writings of eminent ministers and lofty scholars; the edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Zeng Gong won approval to collect writings of famous ministers and recluses.

sentences.zh: 涇原節制王中正入宥州。

translations.literal: Jingyuan controller Wang Zhongzheng entered Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhongzheng of Jingyuan entered Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guimao, first of month: the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, guimao new moon: a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，諸軍合攻靈州，种諤敗夏人于黑水。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the allied armies jointly attacked Lingzhou; Zhong E defeated Xia on the Black Water.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the coalition besieged Lingzhou while Zhong E routed Xia on the Black Water.

sentences.zh: 己丑，李憲敗夏人於囉逋川。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Li Xian defeated Xia on the Luobu River.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Li Xian beat Xia on the Luobu River.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，种諤降橫河平人戶，破石堡城，斬獲甚衆。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Zhong E received the surrender of Hengheping households, stormed Shibao fortress, and killed and captured in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Zhong E took Hengheping families, stormed Shibao, and slaughtered the garrison.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，師還。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the campaign force withdrew.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，种諤至夏州索家平，兵衆三萬人，以無食而潰。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Zhong E reached Suojiaping in Xiazhou with thirty thousand troops; they scattered for lack of food.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Zhong E’s thirty thousand starved into rout at Suojiaping.

sentences.zh: 丙午，高遵裕以師還，夏人來追，遂潰。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Gao Zunyu withdrew the army; Xia pursued, and the force collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Gao Zunyu’s retreat turned into a rout under Xia pursuit.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，林廣破乞弟于納江。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinwei: Lin Guang defeated Qi Di at the Najiang.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinwei: Lin Guang crushed Qi Di on the Najiang.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，慈聖光獻皇后禫祭，宰臣王珪等上表請聽樂，不許，自是五表，乃從之。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the end-of-mourning sacrifice for Empress Cisheng Guangxian; chief ministers Wang Gui and others memorialized to permit music; it was denied; after five memorials, it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, after five pleas from Wang Gui and the cabinet, music was allowed at the empress dowager’s end-of-mourning rites.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，遼遣蕭福全等來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Liao sent Xiao Fuquan and others to congratulate the new year.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Liao envoys came for New Year.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸未朔，不受朝。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, day guimao, first of month: court audience was not held.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year, spring, guimao new moon: no court audience.

sentences.zh: 丙申，御宣德門觀燈。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: the emperor viewed lanterns at Xuande Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the emperor watched lanterns at Xuande Gate.

sentences.zh: 己亥，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day jihai: a white rainbow crossed the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, a white rainbow spanned the sun.

sentences.zh: 庚子，責授高遵裕郢州團練副使、本州安置。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Gao Zunyu was demoted to Ezhou training vice commissioner and assigned within that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Gao Zunyu was punished with exile as Ezhou training vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，作新渾儀、浮漏。

translations.literal: Day yisi: a new armillary sphere and clepsydra were made.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, new astronomical instruments were cast.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔再議西討，以熙河經制李憲爲涇原、熙河蘭會安撫制置使，李浩權安撫副使。

translations.literal: Day xinhai, edict: the western campaign was debated again; Li Xian was made Jingyuan, Xihe, and Lanzhou pacification commissioner; Li Hao was acting deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Li Xian was put in charge of the western front with Li Hao as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，親策進士。

translations.literal: Third month, day renchen: the emperor personally examined the jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renchen: the palace examination for jinshi.

sentences.zh: 甲午，策武舉。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the military examination was held.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the military examination was held.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以日當食，避殿減膳，赦天下，降死罪一等，流以下原之。

translations.literal: Day jihai: because an eclipse was expected, the emperor avoided the hall and reduced meals; the realm was pardoned; death sentences were reduced one degree; exile and below were forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, eclipse observances brought amnesty and one-grade sentence cuts through exile.

sentences.zh: 詔杭州歲修吳越王墳廟。

translations.literal: Edict: Hangzhou was to repair the Wu-Yue king’s tombs and temples every year.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou was ordered to maintain the Wu-Yue royal shrines annually.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，鄜延路副總管曲珍敗夏人于金湯。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Fuyan deputy commander Qu Zhen defeated Xia at Jintang.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Qu Zhen routed Xia at Jintang.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賜進士、諸科出身千四百二十八人。

translations.literal: Day yisi: one thousand four hundred twenty-eight jinshi and examination graduates of various subjects were granted office.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, 1,428 degree holders of jinshi and other subjects received posts.

sentences.zh: 丙午，雨土。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, dust fell like rain from the sky.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子朔，日食不見。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renzi, first of month: the eclipse was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, renzi new moon: the eclipse passed unseen.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the emperor returned to the hall and restored meals.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the court ended eclipse austerity and resumed banquets.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遼遣耶律永端等來賀同天節。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Liao sent Yelü Yongduan and others to congratulate the Shared Heaven festival.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Liao envoys came for Shared Heaven.

sentences.zh: 己未，沈括奏遣曲珍將兵綏德城，應援討葭蘆寨左右見聚羌落，詔從之。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Shen Kuo memorialized to send Qu Zhen with troops from Suide city to support the attack on Jialu stockade and nearby gathered Qiang settlements; the edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Shen Kuo won approval to send Qu Zhen from Suide against Jialu and neighboring Qiang camps.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以直龍圖閣徐禧知制誥、權御史中丞。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Hanlin academician Xu Xi was made drafting edicts and acting censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Xu Xi became drafting edict-writer and acting censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，官制成。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the official system was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the new official system was finished.

sentences.zh: 以王珪爲尚書左僕射兼門下侍郎，蔡確爲尚書右僕射兼中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Wang Gui was made left vice director of the Ministries and gate vice minister; Cai Que was made right vice director and palace vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gui became left vice premier; Cai Que became right vice premier.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太中大夫章惇爲門下侍郎，張璪爲中書侍郎，翰林學士薄宗孟爲尚書左丞，翰林學士王安禮爲尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Grand Master of the Palace Zhang Dun was made gate vice minister; Zhang Zan was made palace vice minister; Hanlin academician Bo Zongmeng was made left vice director of the Ministries; Hanlin academician Wang Anli was made right vice director.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Zhang Dun and Zhang Zan took the vice ministries; Bo Zongmeng and Wang Anli became left and right vice directors.

sentences.zh: 錄唐段秀實後，復其家。

translations.literal: Descendants of Tang’s Duan Xiushi were enrolled; the family was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Tang loyalist Duan Xiushi’s line was re-enrolled and restored.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，同知樞密院呂公著罷知定州。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Council Vice Lü Gongzhuo was dismissed to serve as prefect of Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Lü Gongzhuo left the council for Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月辛已朔，行官制。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinsi, first of month: the new official system took effect.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, xinsi new moon: the new bureaucracy went into force.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，賞蠻將士有差。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: southern campaign soldiers were rewarded by grade.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, frontier soldiers received graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，豐州卒張世矩等作亂，伏誅。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Fengzhou soldiers Zhang Shiju and others mutinied and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Zhang Shiju’s Fengzhou mutiny ended in execution.

sentences.zh: 其党王安以母老，詔特原之。

translations.literal: Their accomplice Wang An, because his mother was aged, was specially pardoned by edict.
translations.idiomatic: Wang An, a co-conspirator, was spared for his mother’s sake.

sentences.zh: 作尚書省。

translations.literal: The Ministry offices were built.
translations.idiomatic: The new Ministry compound was completed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔兩省官人舉可任御史者各二人。

translations.literal: Day wuxu, edict: officials of the two chambers were each to recommend two men fit to serve as censors.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, each palace official was told to name two censor candidates.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，遣給事中徐禧治鄜延邊事。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Attendant-in-ordinary Xu Xi was sent to manage Fuyan border affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Xu Xi was dispatched to oversee the Fuyan frontier.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌朔，封御侍武氏爲才人。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengxu, first of month: Attendant Wu was ennobled as Talented Lady.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengxu new moon: Attendant Wu became Talented Lady.

sentences.zh: 壬子，進封均國公傭爲延安郡王。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Duke of Junguo Yong was advanced to Prince of Yan’an.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Duke Yong of Junguo became Prince of Yan’an.

sentences.zh: 以昭容朱氏爲賢妃。

translations.literal: Concubine Zhu was made Honored Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Concubine Zhu was raised to Honored Consort.

sentences.zh: 庚申，帝有疾。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the emperor fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the emperor was ill.

sentences.zh: 詔歲以四孟月朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Edict: in the four seasonal months offerings were to be presented at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Four times a year the court was to worship at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣韓忠彥等賀遼主生辰、正旦。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Han Zhongyan and others were sent to congratulate the Liao ruler’s birthday and new year.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Han Zhongyan’s mission left for Liao.

sentences.zh: 鳳州團練使种諤以行軍迂道，降授文州刺史。

translations.literal: Fengzhou training commissioner Zhong E, for taking a circuitous route on campaign, was demoted to prefect of Wenshi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong E lost rank to Wenshi prefect for marching by a roundabout route.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔罷增減幕職、州縣官奉。

translations.literal: Day renshen, edict: increases and decreases to staff and prefectural salaries were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, salary adjustments for staff and county officials ended.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，城永樂。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Yongle was walled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, fortifications rose at Yongle.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，河決原武。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the Yellow River broke at Yuanwu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Yellow River burst at Yuanwu.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，夏人三十萬衆寇永樂，曲珍戰不利，裨將寇偉等死之，夏人遂圍城。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dinghai: three hundred thousand Xia attacked Yongle; Qu Zhen fought poorly; deputy commander Kou Wei and others died; Xia then besieged the city.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dinghai: three hundred thousand Xia hit Yongle; Qu Zhen was beaten back, Kou Wei fell, and the city was encircled.

sentences.zh: 己丑，帝以疾愈，降京畿囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day jichou: because the emperor had recovered from illness, capital prisoners’ crimes were reduced one degree; penal labor and below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the emperor’s recovery brought capital amnesty down to penal labor.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣使行視畿縣民被水患者。

translations.literal: Day renchen: envoys were sent to inspect flood victims among the people of the capital counties.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, inspectors toured flood-stricken capital counties.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔張世矩等將兵救永樂砦。

translations.literal: Day yiwei, edict: Zhang Shiju and others were to lead troops to relieve Yongle fortress.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Zhang Shiju was ordered to march to Yongle’s relief.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，永樂陷，給事中徐禧、內侍李舜舉、陝西轉運判官李稷死之。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Yongle fell; Attendant-in-ordinary Xu Xi, eunuch Li Shunju, and Shaanxi transport judge Li Ji died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Yongle fell and Xu Xi, Li Shunju, and Li Ji died in the disaster.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔客省、引進、四方館、東西上閣門各置使、副等職。

translations.literal: Day jihai, edict: the Reception, Introduction, Four Directions Hostel, and Eastern and Western Upper Gate offices were each given commissioners, deputies, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, guest and gate offices received formal commissioners and deputies.

sentences.zh: 庚子，安化蠻寇宜州，知州王奇死之，詔贈忠州防禦使。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Anhua Yi raided Yizhou; prefect Wang Qi died; he was posthumously made defender of Zhongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Wang Qi died defending Yizhou against Anhua Yi and was ennobled posthumously.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賞董氈將士有差。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Dongzhan’s soldiers were rewarded by grade.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Dongzhan’s troops received graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，滑州河水溢。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the Yellow River overflowed at Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the Yellow River flooded Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，洛口、廣武大河溢。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinhai: the great river overflowed at Luokou and Guangwu.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinhai: the Yellow River burst at Luokou and Guangwu.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，知延州沈括以措置乖方，責授均州團練副使、隨州安置；

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Yanzhou prefect Shen Kuo, for maladministration, was demoted to Junzhou training vice commissioner and assigned to Suizhou;
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Shen Kuo was exiled to Junzhou for botching the frontier;

sentences.zh: 鄜延路副都總管曲珍以城陷敗走，降授皇城使。

translations.literal: Fuyan deputy commander Qu Zhen, for the fortress’s fall and flight in defeat, was demoted to Imperial City commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Qu Zhen was stripped to Imperial City commissioner for abandoning Yongle.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，修定景靈宮儀。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Jingling Palace rites were revised and fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Jingling Palace ritual was codified.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔贈永樂死事臣徐禧金紫光祿大夫、吏部尚書，李舜舉昭化軍節度使，並賜諡忠湣，李稷朝奉大夫、工部侍郎，入內高品張禹勤皇城使，各推恩賜贈有差。

translations.literal: Day yichou, edict: Xu Xi of those who died at Yongle was posthumously made Grand Master of the Golden Glow and director of the Ministry of Personnel; Li Shunju was made commissioner of the Zhaohua army; both were given the posthumous title Loyal and Lamented; Li Ji was made Palace Grandee and vice director of Works; inner attendant Zhang Yuqin was made Imperial City commissioner; others received graded posthumous favors.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Yongle’s dead were ennobled—Xu Xi and Li Shunju as Zhongmin, Li Ji and Zhang Yuqin among the rest.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，貶知太原府、資政殿大學士呂惠卿知單州。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Taiyuan prefect and Hall academician Lü Huiqing was demoted to prefect of Danzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Lü Huiqing was sent down from Taiyuan to Danzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅朔，罷御史察諸路。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuyin, first of month: censor inspections of the circuits were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuyin new moon: circuit censor patrols ended.

sentences.zh: 壬午，景靈宮成，告遷祖宗神御。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Jingling Palace was completed; announcement was made to move the ancestral spirit regalia.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Jingling Palace was finished and the ancestral regalia were summoned.

sentences.zh: 癸未，初行酌獻禮。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the libation offering rite was first performed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the court first performed the libation offering.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以奉安神御赦天下，官與享大臣子若孫一人。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: because the spirit regalia were enshrined, the realm was pardoned; one son or grandson of each participating minister was given office.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, enshrinement brought amnesty and posts for ministers’ sons and grandsons.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，紫宸殿宴侍祠官。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: a banquet for ritual attendants was held at Zichen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Zichen Hall feasted the ritual officers.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，新樂成。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingsi: the new music was completed.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, dingsi: the new court music was finished.

sentences.zh: 以賢妃周氏爲德妃。

translations.literal: Honored Consort Zhou was made Virtuous Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Honored Consort Zhou was raised to Virtuous Consort.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，塞原武決河。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the breach of the Yellow River at Yuanwu was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Yuanwu Yellow River breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，休日御延和殿，引進對官十人。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: on a rest day he held court at Yanhe Hall and introduced ten officials for audience.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, a rest-day audience at Yanhe Hall brought in ten officials.

sentences.zh: 辛未，西南龍蕃來貢。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the southwestern Dragon Fan tribes came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, southwestern Dragon Fan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬申，遼遣耶律儀等來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Liao sent Yelü Yi and others to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Yelü Yi came from Liao for New Year.

sentences.zh: 丙子，錄永樂死事將皇城使寇偉等十三人及東上閣門副使景思誼等九十人，贈賜有差。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: those who died at Yongle were enrolled—thirteen officers including Imperial City commissioner Kou Wei and ninety others including eastern upper gate vice commissioner Jing Siyi—with graded posthumous gifts and grants.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Yongle’s dead were honored: Kou Wei and twelve other officers, Jing Siyi and eighty-nine more, with graded posthumous rewards.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月丁丑朔，御大慶殿受朝，始用新樂。

translations.literal: Year six, spring, first month, day dingchou, new moon: he held court at Daqing Hall to receive felicitations and for the first time used the new ritual music.
translations.idiomatic: Year six, first month, dingchou new moon: New Year court at Daqing Hall debuted the new state music.

sentences.zh: 儀鸞司徹幕屋壞，毀玉輅。

translations.literal: The Ceremonial Escort Office’s tent-dismantling shed collapsed and destroyed the jade imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: A Ceremonial Escort shed collapse wrecked the jade carriage.

sentences.zh: 甲申，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, a white rainbow crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: he offered at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, he worshipped at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 己丑，層檀入貢。

translations.literal: Day jichou: sandalwood tribute arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, sandalwood tribute was received.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，御宣德門觀燈。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: he viewed the lanterns at Xuande Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, he watched lantern displays at Xuande Gate.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔御史六察罷上下半年更易法。

translations.literal: Day guisi, edict: the Censorate’s six circuit inspectors were to cease the semiannual rotation rule.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the six Censorate circuit inspectors ended semiannual rotation.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔修周、漢以來陵廟。

translations.literal: Day yiwei, edict: mausoleums and temples from Zhou and Han times onward were to be repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Zhou- and Han-era imperial tombs and temples were ordered restored.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，御崇政殿閱武士。

translations.literal: Day yisi: he reviewed warriors at Chongzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, he inspected troops at Chongzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙午，封楚三閭大夫屈平爲忠潔侯。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Qu Ping, Lord of Three Wards of Chu, was enfeoffed as Marquis Loyal and Pure.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Qu Yuan was enfeoffed Marquis Loyal and Pure.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，夏人數十萬衆攻蘭州，鈐轄王文鬱率死士七百餘人擊走之。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingwei: several hundred thousand Xia attacked Lanzhou; controller Wang Wenyu led more than seven hundred death-dedicated troops and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dingwei: Wang Wenyu’s seven hundred picked men repulsed a massive Xia assault on Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以夏人犯蘭州，貶熙河經略使李憲爲經略安撫都總管，以王文鬱爲西上閣門使、知蘭州，副使李浩爲四方館使。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: because Xia had attacked Lanzhou, Xining frontier commissioner Li Xian was demoted to frontier pacification commissioner-general; Wang Wenyu was made western upper gate vice commissioner and prefect of Lanzhou, and deputy commissioner Li Hao was made commissioner of the Four Directions Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, after the Lanzhou raid Li Xian was demoted to frontier commissioner-general; Wang Wenyu took Lanzhou and Li Hao became Four Directions commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔供備庫使高遵治、西京左藏庫副使張壽各降一官。

translations.literal: Day jiazi, edict: supply depot commissioner Gao Zunzhi and western capital left treasury deputy commissioner Zhang Shou were each demoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Gao Zunzhi and Zhang Shou each lost one office rank.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，夏人寇蘭州，副總管李浩以衛城有功，復隴州團練使。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinmao: Xia raided Lanzhou; deputy commissioner-general Li Hao, for defending the city with merit, was restored to regimental commander of Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinmao: Li Hao’s defense of Lanzhou won back his Longzhou regimental command.

sentences.zh: 乙未，休日御延和殿，引進對官八人。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: on a rest day he held court at Yanhe Hall and introduced eight officials for audience.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, a rest-day Yanhe audience brought in eight officials.

sentences.zh: 丙申，河東將薛義敗夏人于葭蘆西嶺。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Hedong commander Xue Yi defeated Xia at the Jialu Western Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Xue Yi beat Xia at Jialu Western Ridge.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以檢校太尉、上柱國、太原郡開國公王拱辰爲武安軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: acting Grand Marshal, Supreme Pillar of State, and Duke of Taiyuan Wang Gongchen was made military commissioner of Wu’an army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Wang Gongchen became Wu’an military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 麟、府州將郭忠詔等敗夏人於乜離抑部，詔行賞有差。

translations.literal: Lin and Fu prefecture commanders Guo Zhongshao and others defeated Xia at the Nie-li-yi tribe; edict granted graded rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhongshao and other Lin-Fu officers routed Xia at Nie-li-yi; rewards followed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，河東將高永翼敗夏人於真卿流部。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Hedong commander Gao Yongyi defeated Xia at the Zhenqing-liu tribe.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Gao Yongyi defeated Xia at Zhenqing-liu.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiyou: he offered at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiyou: he worshipped at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，遼遣蕭固等來賀同天節。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Liao sent Xiao Gu and others to congratulate the Shared Heaven festival.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Xiao Gu came from Liao for Shared Heaven.

sentences.zh: 甲子，禮部郎中林希上《兩朝寶訓》。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Ministry of Rites director Lin Xi presented the Two Dynasties Precious Instructions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Lin Xi presented the Two Dynasties Precious Instructions.

sentences.zh: 李浩敗夏人于巴義溪。

translations.literal: Li Hao defeated Xia at Bayi Stream.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hao routed Xia at Bayi Stream.

sentences.zh: 辛未，雨土。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, dust fell like rain.

sentences.zh: 壬申，御邇英閣，蔡卞進講《周禮》。

translations.literal: Day renshen: at Erying Hall, Cai Bian lectured on the Zhou Rituals.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Cai Bian lectured on the Zhou Rituals at Erying Hall.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子朔，于闐入貢。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingzi, new moon: Khotan came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, bingzi new moon: Khotan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以時暑，趣決開封、大理獄。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: because of summer heat, Kaifeng and Supreme Court cases were to be decided promptly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, summer heat sped Kaifeng and Supreme Court trials.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以旱，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: because of drought, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, drought prompted a prison review.

sentences.zh: 甲午，夏人寇蘭州，右侍禁韋定死之。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Xia raided Lanzhou; right attendant guard Wei Ding died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Wei Ding fell defending Lanzhou against Xia.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔賜資州孝子支漸粟帛。

translations.literal: Day guimao, edict: grain and cloth were granted to Zizhou filial son Zhi Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the filial son Zhi Jian of Zizhou received grain and cloth.

sentences.zh: 是月，夏人寇麟州，知州訾虎敗之。

translations.literal: That month: Xia raided Lin Prefecture; prefect Zi Hu defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Zi Hu beat back a Xia raid on Linzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳朔，詔御史台六察各置御史一員。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yisi, new moon, edict: each of the Censorate’s six circuit inspections was to have one censor.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yisi new moon: each of the six Censorate inspections gained a dedicated censor.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔御史中丞、兩省官各舉可任言事或監察御史五人。

translations.literal: Day guichou, edict: the censor-in-chief and officials of the two inner courts were each to recommend five men fit for remonstrance office or for censor posts.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the censor-in-chief and inner-court officials each nominated five men for remonstrance or censor duty.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙亥朔，夏主秉常請修貢，許之。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day yihai, new moon: Xia ruler Bingchang asked to resume tribute; permission granted.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, yihai new moon: Bingchang’s tribute mission was allowed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔陝西、河東毋輒出兵。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, edict: Shaanxi and Hedong were not to send troops without authorization.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Shaanxi and Hedong were forbidden to mobilize on their own.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔內外文武各舉應武舉一人。

translations.literal: Day bingxu, edict: civil and military officials inside and outside the capital were each to recommend one man for the military examination.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, every office was to nominate one candidate for the military exam.

sentences.zh: 汴水溢。

translations.literal: The Bian Canal overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: The Bian Canal burst its banks.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太師、守司徒、韓國公富弼薨，諡文忠。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Grand Mentor, acting Minister of Works, and Duke of Han Fu Bi died; posthumous title Loyal.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Grand Mentor Fu Bi died and was posthumously styled Loyal.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，祔孝惠、孝章、淑德、章懷皇后于廟。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yimao: Empresses Xiaohui, Xiaozhang, Shude, and Zhanghuai were enshrined in the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yimao: Empresses Xiaohui, Xiaozhang, Shude, and Zhanghuai entered the imperial temple.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以四後祔廟，降京畿囚罪一等，流以下原之。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: because the four empresses were enshrined, capital-region prisoners had crimes reduced one degree and those below exile were released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the four empresses’ enshrinement brought a one-grade amnesty in the capital circuit and release below exile.

sentences.zh: 孫固罷知河陽。

translations.literal: Sun Gu left as administrator of Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Gu left the Heyang post.

sentences.zh: 以同知樞密院韓縝知樞密院，戶部尚書安燾同知樞密院。

translations.literal: Associate Military Affairs Commissioner Han Zhen was made Military Affairs Commissioner; Minister of Revenue An Tao was made associate commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Han Zhen became Military Affairs Commissioner and An Tao his associate.

sentences.zh: 戊午，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: he offered at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, he worshipped at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，賜升祔陪祠官宴於尚書省。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingzi: officials of the elevated enshrinement collateral sacrifice were feasted at the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, bingzi: collateral-sacrifice officials dined at the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，遣蔡京等賀遼主生辰、正旦。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Cai Jing and others were sent to congratulate the Liao ruler’s birthday and New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Cai Jing led the Liao birthday and New Year mission.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，蒲宗孟罷，王安禮爲尚書左丞，吏部尚書李清臣爲尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Pu Zongmeng left office; Wang Anli became left vice director of the Ministry of Revenue; Minister of Personnel Li Qingchen became right vice director.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Pu Zongmeng stepped down; Wang Anli and Li Qingchen became left and right vice ministers.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guimao, new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guimao new moon: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉朔，秉常遣使上表，請復修職貢，乞還舊疆。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guiyou, new moon: Bingchang sent envoys with a memorial asking to resume tribute duties and begging return of the old borders.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, guiyou new moon: Bingchang asked to restore tribute and recover former territory.

sentences.zh: 戊子，封孟軻爲鄒國公。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Mencius was enfeoffed Duke of Zou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Mencius became Duke of Zou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，會稽郡王世清薨。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Prince Shiqing of Kuaiji commandery died.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Prince Shiqing of Kuaiji died.

sentences.zh: 庚子，尚書省成。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the Ministry of Revenue building was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the Ministry of Revenue hall was finished.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，封馬援爲忠顯王。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Ma Yuan was enfeoffed King Loyal and Manifest.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Ma Yuan was enfeoffed King Loyal and Manifest.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，加上仁宗諡曰體天法道極功全德神文聖武睿哲明孝皇帝，英宗曰體乾應曆隆功盛德憲文肅武睿神宣孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guimao: posthumous titles were added for Renzong as Emperor of Embodying Heaven, Governing the Way, Utmost Merit, Complete Virtue, Divine Culture, Sagely Martiality, Sagely Wisdom, and Bright Filiality, and for Yingzong as Emperor of Embodying Qian, Responding to the Calendar, Grand Achievement, Abundant Virtue, Constitutional Culture, Solemn Martiality, Sagely Spirit, and Proclaiming Filiality.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guimao: Renzong and Yingzong received their full posthumous honorific titles.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: he offered at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, he worshipped at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，朝享太廟。

translations.literal: Day yisi: he offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, he worshipped at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 丙午，祀昊天上帝於圜丘，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: he sacrificed to August Heaven at the Circular Mound; an empire-wide amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Heaven was sacrificed to at the Circular Mound and the realm was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，文彥博乙太師致仕。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Wen Yanbo, as Grand Mentor, retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Grand Mentor Wen Yanbo retired.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以觀文殿大學士韓絳爲建雄軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Han Jiang, Hanlin academician of the Hall of Literary Glory, was made military commissioner of Jianxiong army.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Han Jiang became Jianxiong military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚申，幸尚書省，官執政五服內未仕者一人，進尚書以下官一等。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: he visited the Ministry of Revenue; one unappointed kinsman within five degrees of mourning of each chief minister was advanced one rank below director and below.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, at the Ministry of Revenue each chief minister’s unplaced fifth-degree mourner gained one rank up to director and below.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月丙午，封洺州防禦使世准爲安定郡王。

translations.literal: Year seven, spring, first month, day bingwu: Luozhou defense commissioner Shizhun was enfeoffed Prince of Anding commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Year seven, first month, bingwu: Shizhun became Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，夏人寇蘭州，李憲等擊走之。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Xia raided Lanzhou; Li Xian and others drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Li Xian repulsed a Xia raid on Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以賢妃朱氏爲德妃。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Lady of Worthy Favor Zhu was advanced to Lady of Virtuous Favor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Zhu of Worthy Favor became Virtuous Favor.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，太師文彥博入覲，置酒垂拱殿。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiaxu: Grand Mentor Wen Yanbo entered audience; wine was set out at Chui’gong Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiaxu: retired Grand Mentor Wen Yanbo was received and feasted at Chui’gong Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸未，進封濮陽郡王宗暉爲嗣濮王，封宗晟爲高密郡王，宗綽爲建安郡王，宗隱爲安康郡王，宗瑗爲漢東郡王，宗愈爲華原郡王。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Prince of Puyang Zonghui was advanced to heir Prince of Pu; Zongcheng was enfeoffed Prince of Gaomi; Zongchuo Prince of Jian’an; Zongyin Prince of Ankang; Zongyuan Prince of Handong; Zongyu Prince of Huayuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Zonghui became heir Prince of Pu while Zongcheng, Zongchuo, Zongyin, Zongyuan, and Zongyu received new princely titles.

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑，賜文彥博宴于瓊林苑，帝制詩以賜之。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinchou: Wen Yanbo was feasted at Qionlin Garden; the emperor composed a poem and bestowed it.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinchou: Wen Yanbo was banqueted at Qionlin Garden and given an imperial poem.

sentences.zh: 庚申，御崇政殿大閱。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: a grand review was held at Chongzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, troops were reviewed at Chongzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔賜鬼章寫經紙，還其所獻馬。

translations.literal: Day renxu, edict: Gui Zhang was granted sutra-copying paper and his presented horses were returned.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Gui Zhang received paper for copying sutras and had his tribute horses sent back.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day guihai: a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, a white rainbow crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，大食國來貢。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinwei: the Dashi state came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, xinwei: Dashi sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遼遣蕭浹等來賀同天節。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Liao sent Xiao Jia and others to congratulate the Shared Heaven festival.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Xiao Jia came from Liao for Shared Heaven.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賜饒州童子朱天錫五經出身。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Raozhou boy Zhu Tiansi was granted Five Classics graduate status.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Zhu Tiansi of Raozhou passed the Five Classics examination.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，景靈宮天元殿門生芝草六本。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: six stalks of auspicious fungus grew on the Tianyuan Hall gate of Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, six lucky fungus stalks appeared at Jingling’s Tianyuan gate.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day renchen: he offered at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, he worshipped at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，夏人寇延州安塞堡，將官呂真敗之。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Xia raided Yanzhou’s An’ai stockade; commander Lü Zhen defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Lü Zhen beat back Xia at Yanzhou’s An’ai stockade.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，慮囚，降死罪一等，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renzi: prisoners were reviewed; death sentences were reduced one degree and those below the rod were released.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renzi: a prison review cut death sentences one grade and freed lesser offenders.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, a white rainbow crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以孟軻配食文宣王，封荀況、楊雄、韓愈爲伯，並從祀。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Mencius was given paired sacrifice with the Cultural Progenitor King; Xun Kuang, Yang Xiong, and Han Yu were enfeoffed as earls and added to collateral sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Mencius joined Confucius’s sacrifice; Xunzi, Yang Xiong, and Han Yu became collateral earls.

sentences.zh: 詔諸路帥臣、監司等舉大使臣爲將領。

translations.literal: Edict: circuit commanders, transport commissioners, and others were to recommend grand ministers fit for generalship.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit chiefs were told to nominate senior men for field command.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，夏人寇德順軍，巡檢王友死之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingzi: Xia raided Deshun army; inspector Wang You died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, bingzi: Wang You fell when Xia raided Deshun army.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，江夏郡王宗惠薨。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Prince Zonghui of Jiangxia commandery died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Prince Zonghui of Jiangxia died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，伊、洛溢，河決元城。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiachen: the Yi and Luo overflowed and the Yellow River breached at Yuancheng.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jiachen: the Yi and Luo flooded and the Yellow River broke at Yuancheng.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣使振恤，賜溺死者家錢。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: envoys were sent to relieve distress; families of the drowned were granted cash.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, relief envoys went out and drowning victims’ kin received cash.

sentences.zh: 壬子，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day renzi: he offered at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, he worshipped at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，王安禮罷。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Wang Anli left office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Wang Anli stepped down.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，詔王光祖遣人招諭乞弟，許出降免罪補官。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengwu, edict: Wang Guangzu was to send men to summon Qidi, promising that surrender would spare punishment and grant office.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengwu: Wang Guangzu was to offer Qidi surrender without punishment and with an official post.

sentences.zh: 是歲，乞弟死。

translations.literal: That year: Qidi died.
translations.idiomatic: That year Qidi died.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，遣陳睦等賀遼主生辰、正旦。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Chen Mu and others were sent to congratulate the Liao ruler’s birthday and New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Chen Mu led the Liao birthday and New Year mission.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，西南龍蕃來貢。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renyin: the southwestern Dragon Fan tribes came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renyin: southwestern Dragon Fan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，三佛齊來貢。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Srivijaya came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Srivijaya sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，夏人圍定西城，熙河將秦貴敗之。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Xia besieged Dingxi city; Xining commander Qin Gui defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Qin Gui lifted a Xia siege of Dingxi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，夏人寇熙河。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yihai: Xia raided the Xining circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yihai: Xia raided Xining circuit.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，饒州童子朱天申對於睿思殿，賜五經出身。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Raozhou boy Zhu Tianshen was examined in Ruisi Hall and granted Five Classics graduate status.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Zhu Tianshen of Raozhou passed the Five Classics exam in Ruisi Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: he offered at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, he worshipped at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔分畫交阯界，以六縣二峒賜之。

translations.literal: Day wuzi, edict: the Jiaozhi border was to be redrawn; six counties and two mountain valleys were granted them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Jiaozhi’s border was reset and six counties and two valleys were ceded.

sentences.zh: 乙未，夏人寇靜邊砦，涇原將彭孫敗之。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Xi Xia raided Jingbian stockade; Jingyuan general Peng Sun defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Xi Xia hit Jingbian stockade and Peng Sun of Jingyuan repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉朔，寇清邊砦，隊將白玉、李貴死之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dingsyou new moon: they raided Qingbian stockade; squad commanders Bai Yu and Li Gui died.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingsyou new moon: Qingbian stockade was raided; squad leaders Bai Yu and Li Gui were killed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，夏國主秉常遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Xia ruler Bingchang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Bingchang of Xia sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Venus shone at noon.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，端明殿學士司馬光上《資治通鑒》，以光爲資政殿學士，降詔獎諭。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuchen: Duanming Hall academician Sima Guang presented the Comprehensive Mirror to Aid in Government; Guang was made academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance; an edict of praise and encouragement was issued.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wuchen: Sima Guang of Duanming Hall submitted the Comprehensive Mirror; he was made an Assisting Governance academician and praised by edict.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔門下、中書外省官同舉言事御史。

translations.literal: Day gengyin, edict: officials of the Secretariat-Chancellery and Outer Court were jointly to recommend remonstrance censors who address affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the Secretariat-Chancellery and Outer Court were told to nominate policy-remonstrance censors together.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，遼遣耶律襄等來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Liao sent Yelü Xiang and others to congratulate New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Yelü Xiang of Liao came for the New Year audience.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河東饑。

translations.literal: That year, Hedong had famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hedong starved.

sentences.zh: 河北水，壞洺州廬舍，蠲其稅。

translations.literal: Hebei flooded; housing in Mozhou was destroyed; its taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei floods wrecked Mozhou homes and its taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月戊戌，帝不豫。

translations.literal: Year eight, spring, first month, day wuxu: the emperor was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: Year eight, spring, first month, wuxu: the emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: amnesty for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，使輔臣代禱景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day yisi: chief ministers were sent to pray at Jingling Palace on his behalf.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, chief ministers prayed at Jingling Palace for him.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，分遣群臣禱於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: Day yimao: various ministers were dispatched to pray at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, officials were sent to pray at Heaven and Earth, the temples, and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，開寶寺貢院火。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinsi: the Kaibao Temple examination compound caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, xinsi: the Kaibao Temple examination yard burned.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命禮部鎖試別所。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the Ministry of Rites was ordered to hold the sealed examination at another site.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Ministry of Rites locked the exams at a separate venue.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上疾甚，遷御福寧殿，三省、樞密院入見，請立皇太子及請皇太后權同聽政，許之。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the emperor's illness was grave; he moved to Fukuning Palace; the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs entered audience, asking to install the crown prince and that the empress dowager co-rule; assent.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, he was gravely ill and moved to Fukuning Palace; the Three Departments and Military Affairs Bureau asked for a crown prince and empress-dowager regency—and were allowed.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午朔，立延安郡王傭爲皇太子，賜名煦，皇太后權同處分軍國事。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiawu, new moon: Prince of Yan'an Yong was made crown prince, given the name Xu; the empress dowager was to co-administer state and military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiawu new moon: Prince Yong of Yan'an became crown prince and was named Xu; the empress dowager would govern with him.

sentences.zh: 乙未，赦天下，遣官告於天地、宗廟、社稷、諸陵。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: amnesty for all under Heaven; officials were sent to announce at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, the altars of soil and grain, and the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the realm was pardoned and envoys reported to Heaven, Earth, temples, altars, and tombs.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，皇太后命吏部尚書曾孝寬爲冊立皇太子禮儀使。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the empress dowager appointed Ministry of Personnel director Zeng Xiaokuan ritual commissioner for crowning the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the empress dowager named Zeng Xiaokuan of the Ministry of Personnel to oversee the investiture rites.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上崩于福寧殿，年三十有八。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the emperor died at Fukuning Palace, age thirty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, he died in Fukuning Palace at thirty-eight.

sentences.zh: 皇太子即皇帝位，尊皇太后爲太皇太后，皇后爲皇太后，德妃朱氏爲皇太妃。

translations.literal: The crown prince took the throne; the empress dowager was honored as grand empress dowager, the empress as empress dowager, and Worthy Consort Zhu as imperial noble consort.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince succeeded; the empress dowager became grand empress dowager, the empress empress dowager, and Worthy Consort Zhu imperial noble consort.

sentences.zh: 太皇太后權同處分軍國事。

translations.literal: The grand empress dowager co-administered state and military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The grand empress dowager governed state affairs with him.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，上大行皇帝諡曰英文烈武聖孝皇帝，廟號神宗。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jihai: the late emperor's posthumous title was set as Civil Accomplishment, Fierce Martial, Sagely Filial Emperor; his temple name was Shenzong.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jihai: the late emperor was titled Civil Accomplishment, Fierce Martial, Sagely Filial and temple-named Shenzong.

sentences.zh: 十月乙酉，葬於永裕陵。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day yiyou: he was buried at Yongyu Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yiyou: burial at Yongyu Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：帝天性孝友，其入事兩宮，必侍立終日，雖寒暑不變。

translations.literal: Eulogy: by nature filial and fraternal; when he attended the two palaces he stood in service all day without change in heat or cold.
translations.idiomatic: Appraisal: naturally filial and brotherly, he waited on the two palaces all day through heat and cold alike.

sentences.zh: 嘗與岐、嘉二王讀書東宮，侍講王陶講諭經史，輒相率拜之，由是中外翕然稱賢。

translations.literal: Once, with the Qi and Jia princes he studied in the Eastern Palace; when lecturer Wang Tao expounded the classics and histories they led one another to bow to him—inside and outside thereupon praised his worth as one.
translations.idiomatic: In the Eastern Palace he read with the Qi and Jia princes; when Wang Tao lectured on the classics they bowed together—and court and country called him worthy.

sentences.zh: 其即位也，小心謙抑，敬畏輔相，求直言，察民隱，恤孤獨，養耆老，振匱乏。

translations.literal: At his accession he was cautious and humble, in awe of his ministers, sought blunt counsel, inspected the people's hidden grievances, pitied the orphaned and lonely, nurtured the aged, and relieved want.
translations.idiomatic: On taking the throne he was modest before his ministers, welcomed blunt speech, looked into hidden wrongs, and cared for orphans, the aged, and the poor.

sentences.zh: 不治宮室，不事遊幸，曆精圖治，將大有爲。

translations.literal: He did not repair palaces, did not indulge in tours, devoted himself to governing, and intended great deeds.
translations.idiomatic: He built no palaces, made no pleasure tours, and bent every effort to rule—aiming at great achievement.

sentences.zh: 未幾，王安石入相。

translations.literal: Before long, Wang Anshi entered as chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Wang Anshi became chief minister.

sentences.zh: 安石爲人，悻悻自信，知祖宗志吞幽薊、靈武，而數敗兵，帝奮然將雪數世之恥，未有所當，遂以偏見曲學起而乘之。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi was obstinate and self-confident; knowing the ancestors' wish to swallow You, Ji, and Lingwu while armies repeatedly failed, the emperor burned to erase generations of shame and, finding no fitting course, Wang rose on biased narrow learning.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi was stubborn and sure of himself; seeing how the founders had wanted You, Ji, and Lingwu yet armies kept failing, the emperor burned to wipe away generations of shame—and Wang, with warped learning, seized the moment.

sentences.zh: 青苗、保甲、均輸、市易、水利之法既立，而天下洶洶騷動，慟哭流涕者接踵而至。

translations.literal: Once the Green Sprouts, Baojia, equal transport, market trade, and water conservancy laws were in place, the realm seethed and mourners weeping tears came one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Green Sprouts, Baojia, equal transport, market trade, and waterworks followed—and the land boiled while weeping protesters poured in.

sentences.zh: 帝終不覺悟，方斷然廢逐元老，擯斥諫士，行之不疑。

translations.literal: The emperor never awakened; he decisively expelled veteran elders and shut out remonstrators, executing the laws without doubt.
translations.idiomatic: He never woke to it: he drove out senior statesmen, silenced critics, and pushed the laws through without hesitation.

sentences.zh: 卒致祖宗之良法美意，變壞幾盡。

translations.literal: In the end the ancestors' good laws and fine intentions were nearly all ruined.
translations.idiomatic: At last the founders' sound laws and good aims were almost wholly undone.

sentences.zh: 自是邪佞日進，人心日離，禍亂日起。

translations.literal: Then crafty men advanced daily, hearts daily estranged, and calamities arose daily.
translations.idiomatic: After that flatterers rose day by day, loyalty thinned, and troubles multiplied.

sentences.zh: 惜哉！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!
